rows.grounds: instrumental of kalpa, method or procedure
compound adjective in genitive singular masculine
participle describing one served or treated with aphrodisiac

items.question: What age and preparatory conditions qualify a man for virility-increasing yogas?
premises: Virility-increasing yogas require purity and health.
Practice is barred before sixteen and after seventy.
Method, unburnt age, and aphrodisiac use qualify.
items.inference: Eligibility depends on age window and preparatory regimen.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of adagdhavayaso is uncertain.
Whether vājīkaraṇasevitaḥ is adjectival or participial is uncertain.
items.plain_english: By method, one of unburnt age, served with aphrodisiac.
